slides.texte_overlay:
How to become a
high-value man

Own your mornings:
– Same wake-up time.
– No phone for the first hour.
– Move before you scroll.

Be reliable:
– Answer messages.
– Be on time.
– Do what you said,
when you said.

Keep learning:
– Read every week.
– Ask better questions.
– Learn one new thing
a day.
slides.texte_sophia:
Keep learning:
– Read every week.
– Ask better questions.
– One lesson a day
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
Treat people well:
– The waiter like the boss.
– Remember names.
– Give credit freely.

Take care of the basics:
– Sleep.
– Train.
– Keep your space clean.
